summary: No installer-harm indicators observed in uac-package@1.4.8
details: No behaviors consistent with credential exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent relay, dropper activity, backdoor, or dependency-tree hijack were identified in this version of uac-package. No lifecycle scripts fetching external content, no reads of installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profile stores), and no hardcoded outbound network destinations were observed.
